company.name: Electro Motion (always two words in text; the domain is electmotion.com)
company.email: info@electmotion.com (placeholder mailbox until the owner confirms it)
company.what_we_do: Egyptian company that imports and supplies cables and electrical components for infrastructure, utilities and railways.
audiences: railway and metro authorities and operators

content_rules: NEVER invent facts: no founding year, client names, project references, certifications (ISO etc.), manufacturer partnerships, statistics, phone numbers, addresses or testimonials. If a page needs one, use neutral wording or release the task as blocked with what the owner must supply.
Standards (IEC/EN/ITU) may be named as specifications we source against, never as certifications we hold.
Product ranges are 'typical' and 'subject to project specification'.
Voice: confident, technical, concise. British English spelling (fibre, programme). Short sentences. No hype words like 'world-class' or 'best-in-class'.
Every page: one h1, meta description 50-170 chars, lang attribute, skip link, shared header/footer, loads assets/css/styles.css and assets/js/main.js.
Arabic pages live under /ar/ with <html lang="ar" dir="rtl"> and use the Cairo or IBM Plex Sans Arabic font. Arabic must be natural Modern Standard Arabic suitable for Egyptian business readers.

design.tokens: Defined as CSS custom properties at the top of assets/css/styles.css. Reuse them; do not introduce new colours without adding a token.
design.style: Dark high-voltage chrome (header, hero, CTA, footer) around light readable sections. Line-art SVG illustrations with animated 'current flow' dashes. Rounded 14px cards, generous whitespace.
constraints: Static site only: plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step, no frameworks, no npm.
External requests only to Google Fonts. Inline SVG for all icons and illustrations; no stock photos unless the owner supplies them.
Mobile first; test mentally at 360px width. No horizontal scroll.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Keep total page weight small.
Relative links between pages (products.html, index.html#contact) so Cloudflare Pages previews work.

definition_of_done: Consistent header/footer/nav across every page, including links to any new page
